$comment: Hooks declared in a Skill's own frontmatter are registered when that skill is invoked and, as verified live on Claude Code 2.1.318, stay registered for the rest of that session (docs/adr/0042-claude-host-reverified-on-2-1-318.md). All six KRYLO gate/telemetry hooks (question-gate, risk-gate, posttool-telemetry, fingerprint, agent-events for SubagentStart/SubagentStop, stop-gate) are declared in plugins/krylo/skills/run/SKILL.md instead of here, so an ordinary Claude Code session that never invokes /krylo:run launches zero KRYLO hook processes; after a run they pass through because no run is active. See docs/adr/0021-hook-scoping-to-run-skill.md. This file intentionally registers no plugin-wide hooks.
